description.en: Sets the shoes and (goalkeeper) glove equipment IDs to use for a match member's model, looked up by character ID or number.
Character ID string, or a numeric character index, identifying the member to equip.
Shoes item ID (string, hashed via CRC32) or numeric ID to equip.
Glove item ID (string, hashed via CRC32) or numeric ID to equip.

True once the call has been processed (the equipment is only actually stored if the member is found; otherwise this is a silent no-op); null if fewer than 2 arguments were given or the call was otherwise invalid.

example.code:
// Equip a match member with a specific pair of shoes and gloves
CMND_BTL_SET_SHOES_AND_GLOVE(0, "ssa0023", "sga0023");
